testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceTrue
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference selects Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without fixed preference selects Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC03_ARMBoundaryValues
testSuite.description: Horizon 5, stable income, LTV exactly 80 and credit score exactly 720 select ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMHorizonBoundary7Years
testSuite.description: Horizon exactly 7 years is still eligible for ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC05_ARMZeroHorizonMaxCredit
testSuite.description: Zero horizon, max credit score 900 and LTV 0 select ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC06_ARMLtvJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.5 exceeds ARM limit and no other rule applies, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC07_ARMCreditJustBelowLimit
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 fails ARM threshold and is above manual review threshold, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC08_ARMHorizonTooLong
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years exceeds ARM limit, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC09_ARMVariableIncome
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM condition, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC10_ManualCreditBoundary640
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 does not trigger manual review and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC11_ManualCreditBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC12_ManualDtiBoundary50
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 does not trigger manual review

testSuite.name: TC13_ManualDtiAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC14_ManualLtvBoundary95
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 does not trigger manual review

testSuite.name: TC15_ManualLtvAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC16_FixedPriorityOverManual
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with credit score 600 matches the first rule (FIRST hit policy) so Fixed30 wins over ManualReview

testSuite.name: TC17_HighSensitivityOverManual
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with DTI 120 matches Fixed30 first, overriding ManualReview

testSuite.name: TC18_NullFieldsNoRule
testSuite.description: Null credit score, horizon, and preferences match no rule, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC19_CashOutHighSensitivity
testSuite.description: Cash-out refinance with high rate sensitivity selects Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC20_CashOutArmEligible
testSuite.description: Cash-out refinance with stable income, horizon 6, LTV 70 and credit 730 selects ARM7/1

cases.description: Fixed30 через явну фіксовану перевагу
Fixed30 через високу чутливість до ставки
ARM7/1: короткий горизонт + стабільний профіль

Конфлікт ARM7/1 vs Fixed (пріоритет → Fixed30)
Виконуються умови ARM7/1, але fixedPreference=true → очікувано: Fixed30

ManualReview через низький кредитний бал
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо creditScore < 640)

ManualReview через високий DTI
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо dti > 50)

ManualReview через високий LTV
Очікувано: ManualReview (бо ltv > 95)

Нейтральний сценарій (жодне правило не підходить)
Очікувано: null або дефолтне рішення (залежно від політики у DMN)
Фіксована перевага + кредитний бал 600 → відсічка переважає
Фіксована перевага + DTI 55 → відсічка переважає
Фіксована перевага + LTV 97 → відсічка переважає
Висока чутливість до ставки + кредитний бал 620 → відсічка переважає
Висока чутливість до ставки + DTI 60 → відсічка переважає
Висока чутливість до ставки + LTV 98 → відсічка переважає
Умови ARM7/1 виконані + DTI 51 → відсічка переважає (кейс зі смоук-прогону)
Умови ARM7/1 виконані + DTI 75 → відсічка переважає

DTI 50.5 → відсічка

LTV 95.1 → відсічка

    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">

          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>

      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">

        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>

      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">

          <text></text>

        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">

          <text>>50</text>

        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>

      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">

          <text></text>

      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference selects Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity selects Fixed30 even without explicit preference

testSuite.name: TC11_DtiAboveFiftyManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 exceeds 50 and routes to manual review

testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC13_LtvAboveNinetyFive
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 exceeds 95 and routes to manual review

testSuite.name: TC14_LtvExactlyNinetyFive
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedOverridesManualReview

testSuite.description: Most decision inputs are null so no rule condition is satisfied

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMBoundaryAllMinimums

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonJustAboveARMLimit

testSuite.name: TC06_VariableIncomeNoARM

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditBelowARMThresholdNoManual

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditBelow640ManualReview

testSuite.name: TC09_CreditExactly640NoManual

testSuite.name: TC10_DTIAbove50ManualReview

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity_Fixed30
testSuite.description: Висока чутливість до ставки без явної переваги фіксованої ставки дає Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC03_ArmBoundaryAllMet
testSuite.description: Межові значення для ARM7/1: horizon=7, LTV=80, credit=720, стабільний дохід

testSuite.description: Коротший горизонт, стабільний дохід, низький LTV, cash-out refinance отримує ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonJustAboveLimit_NoRule
testSuite.description: horizon=7.5 перевищує 7, ARM не призначається, ручний розгляд не потрібен

testSuite.name: TC06_VariableIncomeNoArm
testSuite.description: Змінний дохід блокує ARM7/1, жодне правило не спрацьовує

testSuite.name: TC07_LtvJustAboveArmLimit_NoRule
testSuite.description: LTV=80.1 перевищує 80 для ARM7/1, але не перевищує 95 для ручного розгляду

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditJustBelowArmLimit_NoRule
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал 719 нижчий за 720 для ARM7/1, але не нижчий за 640 для ручного розгляду

testSuite.name: TC09_CreditBelow640_ManualReview
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал 639 нижчий за 640 призводить до ручного розгляду

testSuite.name: TC10_AllBoundariesNoManualNoArm
testSuite.description: Граничні значення: credit=640, DTI=50, LTV=95 не активують ручний розгляд; horizon>7 блокує ARM

testSuite.name: TC11_DtiAboveLimit_ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI=50.5 перевищує 50, призначається ручний розгляд

testSuite.name: TC12_LtvAboveLimit_ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV=95.5 перевищує 95, призначається ручний розгляд

testSuite.name: TC13_FixedPreferenceOverridesManualReview
testSuite.description: fixedPreference=true має пріоритет над ручним розглядом за низьким кредитним балом і високим DTI (FIRST policy)

testSuite.name: TC14_HighSensitivityOverridesManualReview
testSuite.description: rateSensitivity=high має пріоритет над ручним розглядом за DTI вище 50

testSuite.name: TC15_MaxDtiAndCreditLow_ManualReview
testSuite.description: Максимальне DTI=300 та низький кредитний бал призводять до ручного розгляду

testSuite.name: TC16_ZeroLtvMinimalArm
testSuite.description: Мінімальні граничні значення: horizon=0, LTV=0, credit=900 та стабільний дохід дають ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC17_AllNullInputs_NoRule
testSuite.description: Усі вхідні атрибути для правил відсутні (null), жодне правило не спрацьовує

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceTrue
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference triggers Fixed30 under rule 1 with otherwise average attributes

testSuite.name: TC02_RateSensitivityHigh
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity triggers Fixed30 when fixedPreference is false

testSuite.name: TC03_FixedRulePriorityOverManualReview
testSuite.description: Rule 1 has priority under FIRST policy even though credit score, DTI and LTV would also match manual review

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMBoundaryValues
testSuite.description: ARM 7/1 with boundary values: horizon exactly 7 years, LTV exactly 80, credit score exactly 720

testSuite.name: TC05_ARMTypicalCase
testSuite.description: Typical short-horizon borrower with stable income, low LTV and good credit receives ARM 7/1

testSuite.name: TC06_HorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds the ARM limit, no other rule applies, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC07_LTVJustAboveARMLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds ARM threshold and does not trigger manual review (LTV not above 95)

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditScoreJustBelowARMLimit
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below the ARM threshold of 720 and above manual review limit, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC09_VariableIncomeBlocksARM
testSuite.description: Variable income prevents ARM assignment; no other rule matches so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC10_CreditScoreBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640 and routes application to manual review

testSuite.name: TC11_CreditScoreExactly640
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 does not trigger manual review and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC12_DTIExactly50
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 does not trigger manual review because the rule requires DTI above 50

testSuite.name: TC13_DTIAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 is above 50 and routes application to manual review

testSuite.name: TC14_LTVExactly95
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 does not trigger manual review because the rule requires LTV above 95

testSuite.name: TC15_LTVAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 is above 95 and routes application to manual review

testSuite.name: TC16_ManualReviewFromLowCreditWithFixedNotSet
testSuite.description: Low credit score combined with null fixedPreference and low rate sensitivity results in manual review

testSuite.name: TC17_NullCreditScoreWithFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Null credit score does not match manual review, but explicit fixed preference triggers Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC18_AllNullAttributes
testSuite.description: All decision attributes are null, so no rule matches and no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceTrue
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference with otherwise typical attributes results in Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivityOverridesArm
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity matches Fixed30 rule first even though ARM conditions are also met (FIRST policy)

testSuite.name: TC03_ArmBoundaryAllMet
testSuite.description: Horizon exactly 7 years, stable income, LTV exactly 80, credit score exactly 720 yields ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC04_ArmHorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds the 7-year ARM limit and no other rule applies, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC05_ArmVariableIncomeNoMatch
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM criteria and no other rule applies, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC06_ArmLtvJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.01 exceeds ARM threshold, not above 95, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC07_ManualReviewLowCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditScoreBoundary640NoManual
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640, so manual review does not apply and no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC09_ManualReviewDtiAboveLimit
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 is above 50 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC10_DtiExactlyFiftyNoManual
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC11_ManualReviewLtvAboveLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 is above 95 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC12_LtvExactlyNinetyFiveNoManual
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC13_FixedPreferenceOverridesLowCredit
testSuite.description: Fixed preference rule is evaluated before manual review rule, so Fixed30 is returned for low credit score (FIRST policy)

testSuite.name: TC14_ArmWithHighDtiManualOverlap

testSuite.name: TC17_CashOutRefinanceManualReview

testSuite.name: TC18_ManualReviewMultipleConditions
testSuite.description: Credit score below 640, DTI above 50 and LTV above 95 all hold; manual review is returned once

testSuite.name: TC03_ARMBoundaryValuesInclusive
testSuite.description: All ARM criteria at their inclusive boundaries: horizon 7, LTV 80, credit score 720, stable income

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMTypicalCase
testSuite.description: Typical short-horizon borrower with stable income, good credit and moderate LTV receives ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonJustAboveARMLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon of 7.1 years exceeds the ARM limit; no rule matches so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: TC06_LTVJustAboveARMLimitNoMatch

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditScoreBelow640ManualReview

testSuite.name: TC11_DTIAbove50ManualReview

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>

      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">

        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">

        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>

      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><=7</text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><=80</text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">

          <text>>50</text>

        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-6-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.name: FixedPreferenceExplicit
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference assigns Fixed30 under FIRST policy.

testSuite.name: HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without explicit fixed preference assigns Fixed30.

testSuite.name: FixedRuleOverridesManualReview
testSuite.description: Rule order: Fixed30 rule is evaluated first, so low credit score with high rate sensitivity still yields Fixed30.

testSuite.name: ArmBoundaryAllMet
testSuite.description: Horizon exactly 7 years, stable income, LTV exactly 80, credit score exactly 720 yields ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: ArmTypicalCase
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, low LTV, good credit score yields ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: ArmZeroHorizon
testSuite.description: Zero horizon years is within the 7-year limit and yields ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: ArmHorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds the limit, so ARM does not apply and no other rule matches.

testSuite.name: ArmVariableIncome
testSuite.description: Variable income prevents ARM7/1 and no other rule matches, so no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: ArmCreditScoreJustBelow720
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below 720, so ARM does not apply and no manual rule matches.

testSuite.name: ArmLtvJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds 80, so ARM does not apply and no manual rule matches.

testSuite.name: ManualReviewLowCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, triggering manual review.

testSuite.name: CreditScoreExactly640
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640, so no manual review and no other rule matches.

testSuite.name: ManualReviewHighDti
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 exceeds 50, triggering manual review.

testSuite.name: DtiExactlyFifty
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, so no manual review and no other rule matches.

testSuite.name: ManualReviewHighLtv
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 exceeds 95, triggering manual review.

testSuite.name: LtvExactlyNinetyFive
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, so no manual review and no other rule matches.

testSuite.name: ArmOverlapWithManualDti
testSuite.description: ARM conditions are met and DTI 55 would trigger manual review, but ARM7/1 rule comes first under FIRST policy.

testSuite.name: ManualReviewOverlapWithHighLtvAndLowCredit
testSuite.description: Credit 800 and horizon 5 with stable income but LTV 96 fails ARM, and manual review is triggered by LTV above 95.

testSuite.name: NullInputsNoRuleApplies
testSuite.description: Null credit score, horizon, and DTI/LTV fields mean no rule can be satisfied, so no product is assigned.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="application.fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="application.rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="application.horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="application.incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="application.ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.ltv</text>

      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="application.creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="application.dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.dti</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><=7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><=80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">

        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">

        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">

        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>>50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">

        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-6-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.name: FIXED_PREFERENCE_OVERRIDES_ARM_ELIGIBILITY
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference returns Fixed30 even though the applicant also meets all ARM 7/1 criteria

testSuite.name: HIGH_RATE_SENSITIVITY_FIXED30
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without explicit fixed preference returns Fixed30

testSuite.name: FIXED30_RULE_TAKES_PRECEDENCE_OVER_MANUAL_REVIEW
testSuite.description: With FIRST hit policy, the first matching rule (Fixed30) wins even though manual-review conditions are also true

testSuite.name: ARM_BOUNDARY_ALL_MINIMA_MET
testSuite.description: Horizon exactly 7 years, LTV exactly 80, credit score exactly 720, stable income, no fixed preference returns ARM7/1

testSuite.name: ARM_TYPICAL_REFINANCE_RATE_TERM
testSuite.description: Typical refinance applicant meeting all ARM 7/1 criteria

testSuite.name: ARM_HORIZON_JUST_ABOVE_LIMIT
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds 7-year limit; no rule matches so no product assigned

testSuite.name: ARM_LTV_JUST_ABOVE_LIMIT
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds ARM limit and does not trigger manual review; no product assigned

testSuite.name: ARM_CREDIT_SCORE_JUST_BELOW_MINIMUM
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below ARM minimum of 720 but above manual-review threshold; no product assigned

testSuite.name: VARIABLE_INCOME_NO_ARM
testSuite.description: Variable income blocks ARM 7/1 and no other rule applies, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: MANUAL_REVIEW_CREDIT_SCORE_BELOW_640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: MANUAL_REVIEW_DTI_JUST_ABOVE_50
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 exceeds 50 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: MANUAL_REVIEW_LTV_JUST_ABOVE_95
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 exceeds 95 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: BOUNDARY_NO_MANUAL_REVIEW_AT_EXACT_THRESHOLDS
testSuite.description: Credit score 640, DTI 50 and LTV 95 are exact thresholds that do not trigger manual review; no product assigned

testSuite.name: ALL_NULL_ATTRIBUTES_NO_MATCH
testSuite.description: Applicant with all decision attributes null matches no rule, so no product is assigned

testSuite.name: CASH_OUT_REFINANCE_ARM_ELIGIBLE
testSuite.description: Cash-out refinance applicant meeting all ARM 7/1 criteria receives ARM7/1

testSuite.name: MANUAL_REVIEW_WITH_FIXED_PREFERENCE_FALSE_AND_LOW_SCORE_AND_HIGH_LTV
testSuite.description: Low credit score and high LTV with no fixed preference triggers manual review
